text:
ela: quick thread: autofallback triggered by bursty batch errors. ops asked for a minimal control and a single place to override.

ravi: Minimal controls: Pause autobackoff (ttl), Escalate (page), and Add note. Keep defaults conservative.

mae: telemetry: include reason_code (BATCH_ERROR/BANDWIDTH/THROTTLE), event_id, and a tiny list of 3 scrubbed examples. UI shows compact timeline entry.

ops-bot: alert: evt_1765500000 fallback->model-lowcap for route `chat-v2` at 2025-03-13T09:00:00Z reason=BATCH_ERROR.

ela: UX: timeline entry + one-click "pause" opens modal with reason required. store override as persistent with ttl. show who paused in audit.

ravi: API: POST /internal/overrides { scope: "route:chat-v2", ttl:900, operator:"ela", reason:"investigating" } return audit_id.

mae: paging rule: only page if slo_delta_pct>3 OR fallback persists >5m. otherwise slack notify.

ela: follow-ups: Mae wire reason_code and samples to event schema. Ravi create API draft. Ops-bot, replay evt to test endpoint.

ops-bot: will replay evt_1765500000 to /internal/fallbacks/test on request.

ela: thanks, keeping UI minimal but auditable is the goal. :+1:
